craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of stated proof — design inference through lacunae; gaps sung as gaps; FIRST VERSE of the work sets the house voice (terminal doctrine words; owner verdict required). Lordlessness-impossible close; then-hinge. Rejected: (a) could-be→must-be strengthen → killed: L3 modal frozen. Read aloud: HERE-then … NO-lord-less-NESS COULD-be.

lines: Here then — conscious makers proved, the Lord's act proved:
for knowers of such variety, no lordlessness could be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tadatra buddhimatkartṛsiddhyā siddheśvarakriyā na hi tādṛśavaicitryaviduṣaḥ syādanīśitā

reads_against.argmap: What follows from proved makers? → Makers proved prove the Lord's act: variety-knowers cannot be lordless.
c1_essence: Bodies bespeak a conscious maker, like pots: the design inference stated through lacunae (vv1-2).
Variety marks wisdom; matter can't arrange; makers proved prove the Lord — answering neither-potter-nor-Lord with conscious-only pervasion shown (vv5-9).
